q: In 1931 Barcelona lost a league match 12-1. Which club beat them?
sub: Bata scored seven of the twelve. No La Liga side has won by eleven since.

q: Deportivo La Coruña needed a last-minute penalty on the final day of 1993-94 to win the title. Who missed it?
sub: A centre-back took it because the usual taker was off. Barcelona were champions.

q: Which club beat Real Madrid on the final day in both 1992 and 1993, handing Barcelona the title each time?
sub: In 1992 Madrid were 2-0 up and lost 3-2.

q: Real Madrid's 2011 Copa del Rey trophy was wrecked hours after the final. How?
a: Sergio Ramos dropped it off the parade bus and the bus ran over it.
sub: They got a replica. The club had waited 18 years for that cup.

q: Which third tier club beat Real Madrid 4-0 in the 2009 Copa del Rey?
sub: The night is known in Spain as the Alcorconazo. Only 2,997 saw it.

q: Barcelona were unbeaten in the 2017-18 league until the second last game. Which club beat them 5-4?
sub: Emmanuel Boateng scored a hat-trick and Levante led 5-1.

q: Which club finished 13th in 2014-15 and was relegated from La Liga anyway, for unpaid tax?
sub: Eibar, who finished third from bottom, went up in their place.

q: Which club's players refused to kick off against Real Sociedad in a 2014 Copa del Rey tie?
sub: They had not been paid for seven months and stood in a line instead.

q: Which Mexican billionaire rescued Real Oviedo in 2012 after fans worldwide bought shares in the club?
sub: Nearly 37,000 people from 86 countries bought shares at 11 euros each.

q: Barcelona's first agreement to sign the 13-year-old Lionel Messi in 2000 was written on what?
sub: Carles Rexach wrote it over lunch. It sold at auction in 2024.

q: Which Sevilla goalkeeper headed a stoppage-time equaliser at Shakhtar Donetsk in the 2007 UEFA Cup?
sub: Dani Alves took the corner. Sevilla won in extra time and kept the cup.

q: Who finished a hat-trick with an overhead kick on the last day of 2000-01 to put Barcelona into the Champions League?
sub: Barcelona beat Valencia 3-2 and took the last place off them.

q: Which Barcelona assistant coach did José Mourinho poke in the eye during a 2011 Supercopa brawl?
sub: Vilanova slapped him back. Both were banned.

q: Which Spanish club lost the 2001 UEFA Cup final 5-4 to Liverpool on a golden goal?
sub: Their own defender headed the winner past his keeper, with nine men left.

q: Real Madrid's centenary year was spoiled by a 2002 Copa del Rey final defeat at the Bernabéu. To which club?
sub: Spain calls it the Centenariazo. Deportivo won 2-1.
